hebrew: הַלְלוּ אֶת ה', כָּל-גּוֹיִם, שַׁבְּחוּהוּ כָּל-הָאֻמִּים. כִּי גָבַר עָלֵינוּ חַסְדּוֹ וֶאֱמֶת-ה' לְעוֹלָם; הַלְלוּ-קָהּ.
translation:
O praise the LORD, all ye nations; laud Him, all ye peoples.

For His mercy is great toward us; and the truth of the LORD endureth for ever. Hallelujah.

Psalms 117:1-2

Jewish Publication Society 1917 translation (public domain)
